title: Rayforce — Columnar Analytics and Graph Traversal in One Pipeline
excerpt: Pure C zero-dependency embeddable engine where columnar analytics and graph operations share a single operation DAG, pass through a multi-pass optimizer, and execute as fused morsel-driven bytecode.
content_html:
Open source · Pure C · Zero dependencies

Analytics and graphs.
One fast engine.

Rayforce fuses columnar analytics, graph traversal, and recursive queries into one embeddable execution pipeline—built for teams that measure latency in microseconds, not meetings.
